column3: “These are the generations” retains the plural expression instead of “This is the account.”
Names Dodanim where BSB has “the Rodanites.”
Retains “the coastlands of the nations,” rather than naming the inhabitants as “the maritime peoples.”
“It is the great city” remains a separate clause rather than being attached directly to Calah.
Names Heth in the singular, rather than “the Hittites.”
The names Jebusite, Amorite, and Girgashite occur as singular collective designations rather than plural forms.
The names Hivite, Arkite, and Sinite occur as singular collective designations rather than plural forms.
The people names remain singular collective designations; the scattering of their clans is a passive statement.
“The border of the Canaanite” is singular and the directions retain “as you come.”
Retains “their dwelling place” and “as you come toward Sephar,” rather than “Their territory extended.”
